instruction: Repair only the artificial horizontal tone seam across the thin vertical stone foot in image 1, around local y539. This narrow pale upright trim should have a single continuous smooth stone face from top to bottom; remove the rectangular warm/cool change and the tiny mismatched edge kink where it crosses that horizontal line. Keep the trim's outer boundaries, thickness, top and bottom exact. Preserve the big red cylinder, shadows, all other stone edges, paper scraps, broad stone texture and floor exactly. Do not create a new line or band at this seam. This is local color/material continuity and a 1-2px edge cleanup only, not a new pedestal or architectural redesign.
